questions.question: A number is increased by 20% then decreased by 27% and then further increased by 10%. What is the net increase/decrease percentage in the number (correct to the nearest integer)?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the number be 100.

According to the question, the number is increased by 20%

⇒ 100 + 20over100 × 100 = 120

Further, the number is decreased by 27% 

⇒ 120 - 27over100 × 120 = 87.6

Finally, the number is increased by 10%

⇒ 87.6 + 10over100 × 87.6 = 96 (approximated to the nearest integer)

Net change in the number = 96 - 100 = -4

∴ There is a net decrease of 4% in the number.

questions.question: A can do a certain work in 40 days. B is 60% more efficient than A. Both work together for 10 days. C alone completes the remaining work in 10(1)/(2) days. Working together, B and C can complete 44% of the original work in:
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Work done by A in one day = 1over 40

According to the question, B is 60% more efficient than A

∴ Work done by B in one day = 1over 40 × 160over 100 = 1over25 

Work done by A and B in one day = 1over 40 + 1over25 = 13over200

Work done by A and B in 10 day = 13over200 × 10 = 130over200

Work remaining = 1 - 130over200 = 70over200 = 7over20

⇒ C completes 7over20 work in 10(1)/(2) days. 

∴ Time taken by C to complete the whole work = 10(1)/(2) × 20over7 = 30 days

Work done by C in one day = 1over30

Portion of work done by B and C in one day = 1over25 + 1over30 = 11over 150

Time taken by B and C to complete whole work = 150over11

∴ Time taken by B and C to complete 44% of the whole work = 44over 100 × 150over11 = 6 days

**The answer is 6 days.**

questions.question: A man buys 120 toys each at the same cost price. He sells 45% of the toys at 40% profit, one-third of the remaining at 20% profit, and the remaining at a loss which is equal to the cost price of 14 toys. His profit per cent in the entire transaction is:
questions.solution:
**Formula:**

SP = CP + (Gover 100 × CP), where

SP = Selling Price

CP = Cost Price

G = Gain%

Gain = SP - CP

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price of each toy be Rs 1.

⇒ Total cost price = Rs 1 × 120 = Rs 120

SP of 45% toys = 1 + (40over 100 × 1) = Rs 1.4

Total SP of 45% toys = Rs 1.4 × 45over 100 × 120 = Rs 75.6

Toys sold at 20% profit = 1over 3 × (120 - 54) = 22

Total SP of toys sold at 20% profit = 22 × Rs 1.2 = Rs 26.4

Total toys remaining = 120 - (54 + 22) = 44

According to the question-

Total SP of remaining toys = Rs 44 - Rs 14 = Rs 30

Total cumulative SP = Rs 75.6 + Rs 26.4 + Rs 30 = Rs 132

Gain = Rs 132 - Rs 120 = Rs 12

G = 12over 120 × 100 = 10%

∴ **The net profit % is 10%.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** Calculation:

Let CP of one toys is Rs. 1

Then CP of 120 toys is Rs. 120

According to the question,

SP of 45% of toys = 140% of 45% of 120 × 1

⇒ (140)/(100)× (45)/(100) × 120 = Rs. 378/5

SP of (1)/(3) of the remaining = 120% of (1)/(3) of 55% of 120 × 1

⇒ (120)/(100)× (1)/(3)× (55)/(100) × 120 = Rs. 132/5

Now the number of the remaining toys = (2)/(3) of 55% of 120 = 44

CP of 44 toys = Rs. 44

As the remaining toys are sold at loss equal to CP of 14 articles

∴ SP of the remaining toys = 44 - 14 = Rs. 30

So, total SP = (378/5) + (132/5) + 30 = Rs. 132

⇒ Total profit = 132 - 120 = Rs. 12

⇒ Profit% = (12/120) × 100 = 10

**Hence, the required profit is 10%.**

questions.question: A and B together can complete a work in 15 days. If A, B and C working together can complete the same work in 10 days, then in how many days can C alone complete the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A and B to complete the work = 15 days

Time taken by A, B and C to complete the work = 10 days

**Calculation:**

Work done by A and B in one day = 1over15 

Work done by A, B and C in one day = 1over10

Work done by C in one day = 1over10 - 1over15 = 1over30

∴ Time taken by C to complete the work = 30 days

**C can complete the work in 30 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**LCM of 10 and 15 = 30

Let the total work be 30 units

Efficiency of A and B = 30 ÷ 15 = 2 units 

Efficiency of A, B and C = 30 ÷ 10 = 3 units

Efficiency of C = 3 - 2 = 1 unit

Time taken by C = 30 ÷ 1 = 30 days

questions.question: Two possible numbers are in the ratio 7 ∶ 11. If the sum of their squares is 13770, then the difference between the two numbers is:
questions.solution:

Two number ratio = 7 : 11

Sum of the square = 13770

**Calculation:**

Let the two numbers be 7a and 11a.

According to the question:

⇒ (7a)² + (11a)² = 13770

⇒ 49a² + 121a² = 13770

⇒ 170a2 = 13770

⇒ a2 = 81 or a = 9

Difference between the two numbers = 11a - 7a = 4a

∴ Difference between the two numbers = 4 × 9 = 36

**The difference between the two numbers is 36.**

questions.question: The ratio of the incomes of A and B is 2 ∶ 3 and the ratio of their expenditures is 5 ∶ 7. If 7 times the income of A is equal to 6 times the expenditure of B, then what is the ratio of the savings of A and B?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of income of A and B = 2 : 3

Ratio of expenditure of A and B = 5 : 7

**Concept:**

Savings = Income - Expenditure

**Calculation:**

Let the income of A and B be 200 and 300 respectively.

According to the question-

7 × Income of A = 6 × Expenditure of B

⇒ 7 × 200 = 6 × Expenditure of B

⇒ Expenditure of B = 7over 6 × 200 = 700over 3

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c67a76befd3fb9fe78ade000ae76c501c566d0502524ef8aa69d951b1be9fd0.png] 

∴ Expenditure of A = 5over 7 × 700over 3 = 500over 3

⇒ Savings of A = 200 - 500over 3 = 100over 3

⇒ Savings of B = 300 - 700over 3 = 200over 3

Ratio = {100over 3}over {200over 3} = 100over 3 × 3over 200 = 1 : 2

∴ **The ratio is 1 : 2.**

questions.question: The average of 37 numbers is 80. The average of the first 19 numbers is 75 and the average of the last 19 numbers is 84. If the 19th number is excluded, what is the average of the remaining numbers (approximate to one decimal place)?
questions.solution:
**Formula:**

Sum = Average × Total num

**Calculation:**

Sum of 37 numbers = 80 × 37 = 2,960

Sum of first 19 numbers = 19 × 75 = 1,425

Sum of last 19 numbers = 19 × 84 = 1,596

Total sum of 38 numbers = 1,425 + 1,596 = 3,021

Difference i.e., 19th number = 3,021 - 2,960 = 61

Sum of the numbers excluding 19th number = 2,960 - 61 = 2,899

Average = 2,899 / 36 = 80.5 (approximated to one decimal place).

∴ **The average of the numbers is 80.5.**

questions.question: If x + y + z = 4, xy + yz + zx = 1 and x³ + y³ + z³ = 34, then what is the value of 6xyz?
questions.solution:
Given:

x + y + z = 4

xy + yz + zx = 1

x3 + y3 + z3 = 34

Formula:

x3 + y3 + z3 - 3xyz = (x + y + z) (x2 + y2 + z2 - xy - yz - zx)

(x + y + z)2 = x2 + y2 + z2 + 2 × (xy + yz + zx)

Calculations:

Substituting the values, we get-

(x + y + z)2 = x2 + y2 + z2 + 2 × (xy + yz + zx) 

⇒ 16 = x2 + y2 + z2 + 2 × 1

⇒ x2 + y2 + z2 = 16 - 2 = 14

x3 + y3 + z3 - 3xyz = (x + y + z) (x2 + y2 + z2 - xy - yz - zx)

⇒ 34 - 3xyz = (4) × (14 - 1)

⇒ 34 - 3xyz = 52

⇒ 3xyz = -18

∴ 6xyz = -36

**The answer is -36. **
